name: @coding-adventures/forme-collect-by-tag
description: Group an array of documents by tag for tag archive pages.  Pure transform: items + tagsOf accessor → Map<normalisedTag, items[]> + sorted tag-name list.  Tags normalised (lowercase + slugified) so case / punctuation variants collide.  Map-based grouping defends against __proto__-style tag-name pollution.  FM00 v0 §5.4 collector.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
